App store

New features, one tap away

Find it in the editor under Apps. An app adds something new to your site, like a booking calendar or a newsletter signup, and it stays put when you change themes.

How it works

Install, update, remove

  1. 1

    Browse

    Each app has its own page with screenshots, a description, the cookies it sets and the addresses it loads from.

  2. 2

    Install

    The app is added to your site in a single change. Its blocks and settings appear in the editor right away.

  3. 3

    Update or remove

    See what’s new before every update; bigger changes wait for you. Removing an app is one change too.

Available now

Apps in the store

  • CalendlyYour Calendly calendar in a sheet that every booking button opens.
  • MailchimpA pop-up that signs visitors up for your Mailchimp newsletter.
  • Content-based colorsEach page takes its colors from its own photos.

Themes, too

The store has themes on its own tab. A theme only changes the look: fonts, shapes, how colors are used and how blocks are drawn. Your content and apps stay exactly as they are, and you can switch back anytime.

Read about themes

Built in

Safe to try

  • Every install, update and removal can be undone
  • An app only loads from the addresses it declares
  • Its cookies are added to your cookie list automatically
  • No tracking or ad cookies before a visitor says yes
  • Release notes for every version

FAQ

Questions, answered

What happens to my pages if I remove an app?

If a page uses one of the app’s blocks, the editor shows you where, so you can take it out first. Everything else stays as it is.

Do apps update on their own?

Fixes and new features do. A bigger change that could affect your site waits until you tap Update.

Can I have an app made just for my site?

Yes. An app is a folder of blocks, settings and lists. Get in touch.
